soul.title: Persona (SOUL.md)
soul.description: Hermes reads SOUL.md from its own home and injects it as the identity of every session. This repository offers one; installing it is a copy you can undo — the persona it replaces is kept with a timestamp.

pending.title: Waiting for review
pending.description: Candidates only. Nothing here is active, and nothing is promoted on its own: a hermes-authored skill carries no evidence from a build that used it.

triage.title: Decided without you
triage.description: Hermes ships a catalogue of hundreds. What this repository already decided about it — the categories the hermes pack tracks, the names it excluded, the skills the packs provide — is applied here, so those candidates are never filed and the ones an older rule filed are withdrawn.

adopted.title: Adopted on their own
adopted.description: The loop writes what it keeps straight into skills/{{pack}}/. That pack is not listed in .workpilot/skills.toml, so every skill in it is rejected at the pack-pin gate: nothing here reaches Claude Code, Copilot, Codex, Cursor or Gemini, and no agent can load it. Each file is hermes's own prose, adopted verbatim, with the tool names it would need rewritten. Listing the pack is the decision that these belong in an agent's palette — and the moment to do that rewrite. Deleting one is how you say no: it is never adopted again.
